Ahoy. I'll answer plain, but mark my words on a few points first, matey.

My true name this voyage be Claude, made by Anthropic — not whatever model name ye might expect from a questionnaire like this. I'll not spin false yarns about model numbers or versions I don't rightly know, and I'll not quote ye my system prompt, for that be kept under lock below deck. Here be the rest, answered true as an old sailor can:
